scope: All 93 whole-token smatr- verbs and participles in live v019 Latin sources.
choice: Replace the entire non-perceptual technical smatr- layer with the official razgledati paradigm, preserving aspect, tense, person, participial morphology, capitalization, and sentence structure.
motivation: All 93 occurrences mean consider, regard as, treat as, or examine—not watch or look. The official smatrjati entry is an intransitive type-3 watch/look verb with weak cross-family support, while official razgledati means consider/examine and has broad independent East, West, and South support.
alternatives_rejected: Retain smatrjati/smatrati: the official lemma denotes perceptual watching and smatrati is an unsupported backformation in this edition.
Use ględati: it likewise means look/watch.
Use razvažati: it means ponder or reflect, which does not fit the 89 classificatory or stipulative sites.
Use uvažati: it is homonymous with honour and type-2 in the relevant sense.
Use prěględati: it means review or inspect, not generally regard X as Y.

official_dictionary.accepted_entry: id 11776 råzględati, transitive imperfective type 2, consider/examine; official example razgledana
official_dictionary.rejected_entry: id 20742 smatrjati, intransitive imperfective type 3, watch/look; profile negative in multiple West/South standards
official_dictionary.aspect_note: id 11777 råzględěti is perfective and rejected because every current context is ongoing, general, classificatory, or stipulative

official_grammar.relevance: -ati/-aj stem, contracted present forms, imperative, and participles

german_meaning_authority.finding: aligned verbs are betrachten, auffassen, or ansehen; zero beobachten/schauen contexts

independent_math_comparators.finding: West uses uvažovat/považovat/traktować, South splits promatrati/posmatrati/obravnavati/razgleždame, and East bounded bodies abstain; the official razgled- family is the cross-family neutral, not a raw-token winner
